fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Post the address number on both the main residence and each detached structure so responders can distinguish between buildings on arrival.
• Keep a clear path along the sides of the main residence connecting the front yard to the rear to allow responders to move between structures without backtracking.
• Trim vegetation near the detached structures to keep a clear working space around each building.
• Keep gates or passages leading to the rear of the property unlocked or secured with a method accessible to emergency responders.
• Clear the access drive of parked vehicles, equipment, or stored materials that would block a responding unit from reaching the detached structures.
• Mark or identify which access point provides the most direct route to the rear of the property so responders can orient quickly on arrival.
• Keep the walkway between the main residence and detached structures clear of obstacles that would slow movement while carrying equipment.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim back shrubs and low branches that are directly touching or within a few feet of the structure where vegetation separation is limited.
• Thin trees in the cluster nearest to the structure to open space between individual trees and reduce the chance of fire moving from tree to tree toward the house.
• Remove or mow dry grass between scattered shrubs and the structure to break up continuous ground-level burning material.
• Separate shrubs from one another where they grow close together near the structure so fire cannot easily travel between them.
• Cut grass short in open terrain areas that run directly toward the structure.
• Trim low-hanging branches on scattered trees to a height of at least 10 feet above the ground to keep ground-level fire from climbing into the tree canopy.
• Remove dead grass, dead shrub material, and fallen branches that have accumulated near the base of the structure.
• Keep the area immediately around the structure clear of loose plant material, leaf litter, and dry grass clippings.
